post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: A recognised medical qualification and a postgraduate degree or equivalent in the speciality concerned (full conditions below).

qualification.details: The notice lists these essential qualifications: | A recognised medical qualification included in the First or the Second Schedule or Part II of the Third Schedule (other than Licentiate qualifications) to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (Act No. 102 of 1956). Holders of qualifications included in Part II of the Third Schedule must also meet the conditions in sub-section (3) of section 13 of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956. A postgraduate degree or equivalent qualification in the speciality concerned from a medical college/institution recognised by the National Medical Commission (then Medical Council of India). At least three years of experience in the speciality concerned as a lecturer or in an equivalent teaching post in a Medical College/Teaching Institution after the required postgraduate degree. Knowledge of Konkani. | Desirable: Knowledge of Marathi. | Age limit: The notice gives a maximum age of 45 for the Assistant Professor in Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation post.

salary_details.pay_scale: As per revised pay matrix level 11

how_to_apply: The advertisement is published on the CBES Goa portal (cbes.goa.gov.in). Applications are accepted from 9 October 2026 to 23 October 2026. The portal has Register and Login options for candidates, and advertisement 10 Year 2026 is listed under Advertisement Details. The notice does not set out any other application steps.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GMC Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for Assistant Professor in Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation, and it is reserved for PWD candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the GMC Goa Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. When did the GMC Goa Recruitment 2026 application start?
faq.answer: The application window opened on 9 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Who can apply for the GMC Goa Assistant Professor in Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation post?
faq.answer: The single post is reserved for PWD candidates. Applicants also need the qualifications, experience and age set out in the advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for the GMC Goa Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a recognised medical qualification under the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (other than Licentiate qualifications). They also need a postgraduate degree or equivalent in the speciality concerned from a college recognised by the National Medical Commission (then Medical Council of India).

faq.question: Q6. How much experience is required?
faq.answer: Candidates need at least three years of experience in the speciality concerned as a lecturer or in an equivalent teaching post in a Medical College/Teaching Institution after the postgraduate degree.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for GMC Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice gives a maximum age of 45 for the Assistant Professor in Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary of the GMC Goa Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The pay is as per revised pay matrix level 11.

faq.question: Q9. Is knowledge of Konkani compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes. Knowledge of Konkani is an essential qualification, and knowledge of Marathi is desirable.

faq.question: Q10. How do I apply for GMC Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are made through the CBES Goa portal (cbes.goa.gov.in), which has Register and Login options, between 9 October 2026 and 23 October 2026.
